mods.abstract: Student Research and Creative Inquiry Day is an annual event at Tennessee Technological University that celebrates the innovative research and creative achievements of undergraduate and graduate students. Established in 2005 as "Student Research Day," the event has evolved into a dynamic, campus-wide showcase of scholarly exploration across all disciplines. Held in a poster session format, the event allows students to present their research findings, creative projects, and academic work to the university community. It features both undergraduate and graduate divisions, with judged poster sessions, awards for outstanding work, and Certificates of Participation for all presenters. In 2016, the event was renamed to reflect its broader scope, and in 2017, the Proceedings of Student Research and Creative Inquiry Day journal was launched through a collaboration between the Tennessee Tech Library and the Office of Research and Economic Development. This annual publication, released each spring, includes abstracts, posters, and papers from the event, including select works from English Department presentations. The journal's final issue was published in 2022. Since 2023, the Office of Research and Economic Development has enhanced its website to host the full proceedings, event photos, and links to posters and papers. Despite the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was successfully held virtually in 2020 and 2021, continuing its mission to promote student research and academic excellence. Source: https://www.tntech.edu/research/research-day/
